feeds.description: Gardening blog by Augustus Jenkins Farmer III. Augustus Jenkins Farmer III is a renaissance plantsman. Born into a family of artists, musicians, and farmers, he fell in love with the natural world early in his childhood and later went on to pursue a formal education in Plant and Environmental Sciences at Clemson University and Botanical Garden Design at the University of Washington.

feeds.title: Alex Calamia Blog
feeds.description: I'm Alex Calamia. I'm a meteorologist with a passion for sharing science and gardening tidbits every morning on TV. I was 13 years old when I first started turning my parent's garden in New York City into a tropical oasis. Now I have a garden of my own, and an organic garden at work that's featured on TV every morning. On this blog, I'll share photos of my garden and tips about how I keep it looking its best through wild weather in South Carolina and New York!
